arguments.sql: SELECT products.line, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS amount FROM order_lines JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN orders ON order_lines.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY products.line
